label_rationale: shares are credited before the token transfer and deposit/withdraw are nonReentrant
mechanism: Grim Finance (Dec 2021): vault deposit reentrancy via a malicious LP token transferFrom; shares minted from a post-transfer pool delta
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'backedShares', 'pooledTokens', 'shareOf']

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

Assume-Guarantee specification for GrimVaultPatched
  target property phi : backedShares <= pooledTokens
  exposure site       : deposit.transferFrom  (external interface call)
  ghost state         : (none)

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During deposit's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['deposit']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {backedShares <= pooledTokens && _status == 1} pre-phase {backedShares <= pooledTokens && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = backedShares <= pooledTokens && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_deposit']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {backedShares <= pooledTokens && _status == 1 /\ true}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => backedShares <= pooledTokens
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['deposit'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback deposit preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
